samples.summary: Date-format preference is persisted from an unvalidated cast, while the sibling theme value in this same delta was hardened to validate on read
samples.evidence: The delta hardens `readStoredTheme` with an `isTheme` type guard so an arbitrary origin-local storage value cannot reach `classList.add`. The parallel preference store is not symmetric: `settings/page.tsx:71` does `setDateFormat(value as DateDisplayFormat)` — an unchecked cast (packages/frontend has no `tsc` lane, so the cast is never even type-checked) that writes whatever the Select emits into `localStorage["wafflebase-date-format"]`. Reads via `getDateFormat` are guarded by `isFormat` (date-format-preference.ts:51), but the failed-write mirror is not: `date-format-preference.ts:48` returns `memoryFormat` verbatim, so a junk value written while storage is unwritable is handed straight back to callers unvalidated. Impact today is nil (the only sink is a string comparison in `formatListDate`, no DOM API takes the value), so this is hardening only — apply the same `isFormat` guard at the write/mirror boundary that `isTheme` now applies at the read boundary.

samples.summary: No other unvalidated reader of the shared theme storage key exists — validation fix is complete (informational)
samples.evidence: Verified the hardening has no bypass: grepped `vite-ui-theme` and `classList.add` repo-wide and all *.html for an inline pre-hydration theme script. The only readers of the key are `readStoredTheme` (now guarded by `isTheme`) and tests; the only other paths into the `theme` state are the `?theme=` URL param (validated to light/dark at theme-provider.tsx:75) and the postMessage handler (origin-checked at theme-provider.tsx:126 and value-checked at :129). `setTheme` call sites (nav-user.tsx:89, settings/page.tsx:29, home/primitives/theme-toggle.tsx:15) all pass literals. No untrusted string reaches `classList.add`. Raised only so the verifier need not repeat this enumeration; not a defect.
